name: Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority (simulated)
mandate:
Simulated General Authority for Regulating the Telecommunications Sector and the Digital Government
(the "Authority" under Federal Decree-Law 3/2003, Art. 1). Its objectives include ensuring that the
sector provides high quality and efficient services and that licensees comply with performance
quality standards (Art. 13); it is solely responsible for regulations on telecommunications services
and their quality standards (Art. 14). It has no health or data-protection mandate.
limitations: Simulation of a role; not an official position of the real institution.
